content:
The highly anticipated fourth season of Ted Lasso is now streaming on Apple TV and has been a massive hit, but there are three other standout new shows on the horizon.

Number one: Dark Matter

Apple TV has a fantastic lineup of sci-fi series. Beyond household names like Severance and Pluribus, there's one show beloved by fans that you might have missed — Dark Matter.

The series is adapted from Blake Crouch's bestselling novel and stars Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly.

Season 2 of Dark Matter premieres on Friday, August 28, with new episodes dropping every Friday until the finale on October 30.

Here's the official synopsis from Apple:

Number two: Mayday

Apple TV has several new titles lined up for this autumn, with most going straight to streaming rather than getting a theatrical release.

Kicking things off is Mayday, an action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh that takes the classic spy thriller and turns it on its head.

Mayday lands exclusively on Apple TV on Friday, September 4.

Here's the synopsis and trailer from Apple:

Number three: Slow Horses

One of Apple's most acclaimed series, Slow Horses, is making its return.

In the streaming era, viewers often wait years between seasons of their favourite shows, but Slow Horses delivers a new season every year, with Gary Oldman leading the team as Jackson Lamb in another gripping spy thriller.

Season 6 of Slow Horses premieres on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes airing every Wednesday through October 21.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, with bundle savings available through an Apple One subscription.
